target: Preserve the meaning and refusals of a twelve-month offer effect in USD through fixed local operations.
model: Authored DAG, CPDAG/PAG endpoint declarations, moment/artifact failures and elementary quadratic sets.
observation_law: Deterministic generated declarations and four timestamp rows; no observational or experimental bank sample.
sampling_unit: A fixed request; accounts are the declared scientific unit, dependent months an explicit unsupported case.
method: Run all 24 frozen cases via library and CLI, each initially and after re-instantiation/restart, plus two same-key horizon conflicts.
assumptions: Supplied graph and causal premises are unverified declarations.
Finite authored inputs cover only their specified boundary; no general method validity is inferred.
Fresh operator stores isolate trial state from historical demonstrations.
uncertainty_claim: No new sampling-confidence claim. Preserve qualification and deterministic set topology; do not relabel sensitivity as confidence.
alternatives: Library versus CLI on identical inputs
Explicit unsupported/refused result versus invented point answer
metrics: graph marks, adjustments, set endpoints, qualifiers, hashes, errors and CLI exits
invocation/active-runner wall time and process high-water RSS

acceptance_rules.pass: All 98 slots match frozen expectations and all 24 parity comparisons pass.
acceptance_rules.negative: Any mismatch; retain full request and response and review the failed boundary.
acceptance_rules.execution_failure: Checkpoint environmental obstruction; do not omit requests or redraw fixtures.

seed_role: Version identity only; no random draws

derivation_review.anchor: Author review approves the exact design within its boundary

successor_review.anchor: Author review approves the exact design within its boundary

screen_operating_characteristics: Deterministic conformance on 98 authored slots; no confidence level, power or general false-accept rate.
width_and_availability_rules: Retain disconnected/unbounded/empty/singleton outputs. Correct refusals pass conformance but do not count as available effect estimates.
fresh_data_provenance: New frozen boundary suite, deterministic authored data, new isolated operator roots; no held-out empirical-performance claim.

decision_chain.business: Whether an offer should be proposed for eligible accounts over twelve months
decision_chain.clock: event <= available < decision; keep leakage and missing-clock failures
decision_chain.information: Declared variables, endpoint marks, causal premises and immutable artifact provenance
decision_chain.identification: Selected supplied-DAG back-door route; ambiguous/latent/dependent cases keep their limited dispositions
decision_chain.estimation: No full raw-data discovery-to-estimation path is installed by this study; supplied-moment failures test context/custody
decision_chain.uncertainty: Preserve class ambiguity and deterministic sensitivity topology; statistical effect calibration remains separate
decision_chain.numerical: Independent exact factorizations on four small quadratic cases; no certified general outer-bound solver
decision_chain.financial: A conditional expression is not a dollar estimate. Without justified identified uncertainty and costs, hold the action for investigation

cost_accounting.measured: All invocation time including failed requests/replay and process startup; active runner time including imports into the store and journaling; parent and child RSS maxima
cost_accounting.excluded: Time between segments, initial interpreter/module startup, simultaneous process-tree memory, author effort and subsequent manuscript/review
cost_accounting.money: No price or bank ROI assertion; local measurements are inputs to later scenarios

evidence_classes.independent_reference: Analytic path blocking, factorization, timestamp ordering and exact context change
evidence_classes.contract_double: Proposed consumer handling only, not executed here and never an accepted sibling integration
evidence_classes.authentic_owner_run: Later accepted request/map/clock plus owner trace, fault results and signed disposition; optional for this proposal

limits: No general PAG/temporal identification or confidence guarantee
Restart replay is not process-kill, multi-host, or exactly-once crash qualification
